nodes.name: power_nonisolated_3v3
nodes.description: Non-isolated 3.3V regulation module using U1 XC6206. It converts external VIN_5V into VCC_3V3 for the STM32F103 and the primary-side supply inputs of both ISO7721 devices. This module is the only provider of the internal non-isolated 3.3V rail and distributes that rail to all non-isolated consumers. It operates in the GND domain and must not create any power or ground bridge to the isolated side.
3.3V LDO for non-isolated side

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 control module in the non-isolated domain. It is powered from VCC_3V3 and acts as the SPI master for the isolated ADS1118 acquisition path. This module sources SPI_SCK, SPI_MOSI, and SPI_CS_ADC toward the isolation barrier and receives SPI_MISO back from the isolated ADC through a separate return isolation path. The MCU uses GND only and must communicate with the isolated domain exclusively through the ISO7721 modules; no direct non-isolated-to-isolated signal, power, or ground connection is allowed. Specific boot, clock, and reset strapping are not planned here because corresponding pins are not provided in the component data.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: spi_isolation_forward
nodes.description: Forward SPI isolation module using one ISO7721 (U4). It carries non-isolated MCU-to-ADC control traffic across the galvanic barrier: SPI_SCK and SPI_MOSI. The primary side is powered from VCC_3V3 in the GND domain and the isolated side is powered from ISO_3V3 in the ISO_GND domain. This module exists only to pass signals across the barrier and must not bridge grounds or rails. It uses both available isolator channels for forward traffic, so ADC chip select is not assigned here.
Dual-channel digital isolator

nodes.name: spi_isolation_return_and_cs
nodes.description: Second SPI isolation module using one ISO7721 (U5). It carries the remaining isolated ADC interface signals across the galvanic barrier: non-isolated-to-isolated SPI_CS_ADC and isolated-to-non-isolated SPI_MISO return data from ADS1118 DOUT. The primary side is powered from VCC_3V3 in the GND domain and the isolated side is powered from ISO_3V3 in the ISO_GND domain. This partition uses the two available channels of the second dual isolator exactly, satisfying the brief requirement to isolate both STM32F103-to-ADS1118 SPI control and ADS1118 return data. No ground or power net may cross the barrier through this module.
Dual-channel digital isolator

nodes.name: isolated_adc
nodes.description: ADS1118 isolated precision ADC module in the ISO_GND domain. It is powered from ISO_3V3 and receives isolated SPI_SCK, SPI_MOSI, and SPI_CS_ADC from the MCU through the isolators, then returns conversion/configuration data on SPI_MISO. REF5050 reference output is routed to one ADS1118 analog input as specified in the brief, with AIN0 reserved for that precision 5.0V reference measurement path. Additional analog inputs remain exposed for isolated-domain signal acquisition planning. This module must remain fully isolated from the GND domain except through the digital isolator signal paths.
16-bit SPI ADC on isolated side

nodes.name: isolated_reference
nodes.description: Precision isolated reference module using U7 REF5050. It is powered from external ISO_5V and generates a precision 5.0V analog reference output that is routed to one ADS1118 analog input for measurement as required by the brief. This module remains entirely in the ISO_GND domain. Because the brief specifies REF5050 VOUT connects to one ADS1118 analog input, this module exposes only the precision analog output and does not provide any cross-domain interface.
5.0V precision reference on isolated side
